vn-not-video: That is not a video file
vn-density-tip: Share of the finest grid this video allows. Higher looks closer but writes a bigger chart
vn-tolerance-tip: Nearby colours merge into one zone; raising it shrinks the chart
vn-aspect-tip: Aspect ratio of the rendered frame; "follow the video" keeps the video's own
vn-err-video-missing: The video file does not exist
vn-err-no-ffmpeg: ffmpeg was not found — set its folder in Settings first
vn-err-range-empty: The selected range is empty — check the start and end times
vn-err-grid-too-large: Grid too large — lower the sample density
vn-err-probe-failed: Could not read the video info
vn-err-decode-failed: ffmpeg failed to decode the video
vn-err-temp-dir: Could not create the temporary directory
vn-err-output-dir: Could not create the output folder
